title: PHP array subscript gap and JSON shape
summary: json_encode only encodes PHP arrays starting from 0 and numbered consecutively into JSON arrays.
detail: After unsetting subscript 1 from [10,20,30], the remaining keys are 0 and 2, and the encoding result is an object with these two attribute names.
boundary: array_values are renumbered consecutively; the renumbered JSON cannot restore previously existing gaps.
relevance: Explain why two attachments with similar content are saved in square brackets and curly brackets respectively.
